description: Model-only action benchmark on held-out AVA v2.2 windows. Ground truth from official AVA annotations; indexes built from raw media by the full pipeline.

selection_rules.negative_order: global AVA frequency, descending, synonyms of present labels excluded

limitations: Movie footage, not lectures or classrooms; speech, OCR, and ambiguity are not covered.
AVA caps object/person interactions at three per person, so negatives are near-exhaustive.
Query wording is fixed per label and was written by the benchmark author, not examiners.
